title: Create a new system
intent: Establish the minimum Golden Path structure without irreversible decisions.
steps: Record the decisions and the boundaries of the first module.
Create the .NET 10 solution with an API project and business modules.
Separate Domain, Application, and Infrastructure inside each module.
Configure REST /api/v1, OpenAPI, Problem Details, and the correlation ID.
Configure JWT Bearer, policies, and default deny.
Configure EF Core, Npgsql, migrations, and health checks.
Create the React application, the typed client, and a minimal design system.
Add unit, integration, and architecture tests.
Configure the pipeline with every mandatory gate.
doneWhen: the API and the frontend build
